name: codeweb
description: See what an edit breaks before you write it. codeweb maps the repo into a deterministic call/import graph. You get an interactive HTML map. Your agents get 27 MCP tools: impact, callers, duplication, risk, dead code, and more. /codeweb builds the map; hooks brief every session and impact-check every edit. Works on this project or any repo you want to review before adopting.
